다음은 두 문장을 의미가 자연스럽도록 한 문장으로 합친 것이다. 그 결과를 중, 어법상 알맞은 것은?15)

①
 You may wonder. + Is it true?
→ You may wonder whether it is true.
②
 I asked her. + Was the book difficult to understand?
→ I asked if the book was difficult to understand.
③
 He sent me the letter. + I lost the letter.
→ I lost the letter that he had sent me.
④
 The train already left. + I reached the station.
→ When I reached the station, the train had already left.
⑤
 Does he know the secret? + That doesn't matter.
→ If he knows the secret doesn't matter.
